# Orlando Family Adventure Overview

This 7-day itinerary for your family of four (two adults, two children ages 8 and 12) to Orlando, Florida, from October 20-27, 2024, focuses on a magical balance of theme park thrills and family relaxation. You'll experience the wonder of Walt Disney World and the immersive worlds of Universal Studios, all while managing a moderate budget.

## Orlando Trip Context

This itinerary is designed to fit a moderate budget of $5000 (excluding flights) for 7 nights and 7 full days of activities. This budget requires careful planning and cost-saving measures, especially for food.

-   **Accommodation:** Assumes a family-friendly hotel or vacation rental with a kitchenette for 7 nights, estimated at $250/night ($1750 total).
-   **Theme Park Tickets:**
    -   **Walt Disney World:** 3-Day Base Ticket, allowing one park per day. Estimated $375 per person ($1500 total).
    -   **Universal Orlando Resort:** 2-Day Park-to-Park Ticket, essential for riding the Hogwarts Express between parks. Estimated $225 per person ($900 total).
    -   Total estimated ticket cost: $2400.
-   **Transportation:** Rental car for the week, estimated $400. This provides flexibility but incurs parking fees at parks (typically $25-30/day).
-   **Food & Incidentals:** Remaining budget of $450 ($64/day) for meals, snacks, and souvenirs. This necessitates packing snacks, bringing drinks, and opting for quick-service dining or self-prepared meals.

## 7-Day Orlando Family Itinerary

Here's a day-by-day plan to maximize your family's fun and manage your budget:

### Day 1: Sunday, October 20 - Arrival & Disney Springs
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
-   **Morning/Afternoon:** Arrive in Orlando, pick up your rental car, and check into your accommodation. Settle in and unpack.
-   **Evening:** Enjoy a leisurely evening at **Disney Springs**. Explore shops, watch live entertainment, and have a family-friendly dinner at a casual restaurant like Earl of Sandwich or Blaze Pizza to save on costs.

### Day 2: Monday, October 21 - Magic Kingdom
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
-   **Morning:** Arrive early for park opening (Rope Drop) at **Magic Kingdom**. Head straight for popular Fantasyland attractions like Peter Pan's Flight or Seven Dwarfs Mine Train.
-   **Afternoon:** Explore Adventureland and Frontierland, enjoy classic rides like Pirates of the Caribbean and Splash Mountain (if open). Find a quick-service lunch.
-   **Evening:** Secure a good spot for the Festival of Fantasy Parade and the "Happily Ever After" fireworks show over Cinderella Castle. Pack snacks to avoid expensive park treats.

### Day 3: Tuesday, October 22 - Hollywood Studios
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
-   **Morning:** Dedicate your morning to **Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge**. Experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run and try to secure a boarding group for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance.
-   **Afternoon:** Explore Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania. Enjoy a quick-service lunch in the park.
-   **Evening:** Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular and end your day with the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular.

### Day 4: Wednesday, October 23 - Epcot
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/globe.svg
-   **Morning:** Start in Future World at **Epcot**. Ride Test Track and Spaceship Earth. If available, try to get a virtual queue for Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind.
-   **Afternoon:** Journey around the World Showcase, exploring the different pavilions. Kids will enjoy the Kidcot Fun Stops. Share snacks or small plates from different countries for an affordable culinary tour.
-   **Evening:** Enjoy dinner in one of the World Showcase pavilions (consider quick service or shared meals) and find a viewing spot for the Luminous The Symphony of Us fireworks show over World Showcase Lagoon.

### Day 5: Thursday, October 24 - Relaxation & Non-Park Fun
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg
-   **Morning:** Enjoy a relaxed start. Have breakfast at your accommodation, then spend the morning at your hotel's pool.
-   **Afternoon:** Consider a round of mini-golf or visit a local playground. Alternatively, explore the shops and entertainment at **Universal CityWalk** (no park ticket needed) for a change of scenery and a casual dinner.
-   **Evening:** Family movie night or board games at your accommodation.
